glsa.title: DTrace: Multiple Vulnerabilities
glsa.synopsis: Multiple vulnerabilities have been found in DTrace, the worst of which could allow denial of service.

background.p: DTrace is a dynamic tracing tool for analysing or debugging the whole system. Specifically, dtprobed is a component of the DTrace system that keeps track of USDT probes within running processes, parsing and storing the DOF they provide for later consumption by dtrace proper.

description.p: Multiple vulnerabilities have been discovered in DTrace. Please review the CVE identifiers referenced below for details.

impact.p: Please review the referenced CVE identifiers for details.

workaround.p: There is no known workaround at this time.
